audit.title: Research-grade biosignal workflow
audit.disclaimer: Study Runner is a research tool. It is not a medical device and produces no diagnosis.
audit.sensors.title: Sensors
audit.sensors.body: EEG, heart and breathing rate, and camera-based emotion estimates are recorded as separate streams and never merged into a single score.
audit.timing.title: Timing
audit.timing.body: LSL timestamps are the reference clock. Tablet events carry their own clock offset so browser and sensor time can be compared honestly.
audit.data.title: Data
audit.data.body: Raw values are kept. Camera frames are analysed and discarded; no video is ever stored. Results are written crash-safe before any upload is attempted.
audit.limits.title: Limits
audit.limits.body: Emotion estimates are model output, not ground truth. Wireless sensors can drop samples; gaps are recorded rather than interpolated.
audit.workflow.title: Lab workflow
audit.workflow.step1: Check every sensor on the dashboard before the participant arrives.
audit.workflow.step2: Load the study, then press Play only when exactly one tablet is waiting.
audit.workflow.step3: Watch the live status during the session; interruptions are recorded, not hidden.
audit.workflow.step4: After the session, verify the saved files and the upload state before clearing the room.
